items.event: US Open final — Sabalenka vs Rybakina
items.line: No.1 Sabalenka bids to become the first three-peat champion at Flushing Meadows since Serena Williams (2012-14); No.2 Rybakina, who beat her in this year's Australian Open final, is the first World No.2 to meet the top seed in a US Open final since 2013.

items.line: USA and Europe are dead level at 4-4 after Friday's foursomes and fourballs at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands. All 24 players go out in Sunday singles; first team to 14.5 points takes the Cup — a tight team-golf finish that gets little airtime in Japan.
